metadata.name: stovia
metadata.description: Stovia: memecoin launchpad with survival markets

instructions.name: accept_admin
docs: Step 2 of 2: the nominated key signs to become admin.

instructions.name: claim_bond
docs: Creator reclaims the bond if the token survived.

instructions.name: claim_winnings
docs: Winner: stake + stake * (losing_pool + bonus) / winning_pool.
If nobody revealed on the winning side, revealed losers are refunded their stake.

instructions.name: commit_bet
docs: commitment = sha256(side_u8 || salt[32] || bettor_pubkey). One bet per bettor per market.

accounts.name: program
docs: Upgrade authority gate: only the program's upgrade authority may initialize.

instructions.name: poke_twap
docs: Permissionless: roll the TWAP accumulator forward to now (clamped at deadline).

instructions.name: post_sealed_results
docs: Resolver-only, once per market, after settle_market. Publishes the aggregate sealed pool
totals and the Merkle root of private payouts the resolver will send via Rings.

accounts.name: sealed_results
docs: `init` makes posting once-only per market.

instructions.name: propose_admin
docs: Admin-only, step 1 of 2: nominate a new admin. Overwrites any earlier nomination;
proposing `Pubkey::default()` is rejected (use a real key, or re-propose yourself to cancel).

accounts.name: revealer
docs: Anyone holding (side, salt) may reveal; the bettor key is bound inside the commitment.

instructions.name: reveal_sealed_bet
docs: Reveals the side only; the amount stays private.

accounts.name: revealer
docs: Anyone holding (side, salt) may reveal; the bettor key is bound inside the commitment.

instructions.name: set_resolver
docs: Admin-only: rotate the sealed-bet resolver key.

instructions.name: settle_market
docs: Permissionless after the reveal window. TWAP over [start, deadline] vs target.

instructions.name: sweep_unrevealed
docs: Permissionless after settlement: unrevealed stakes (and an orphaned bonus when no winner
revealed) go to the treasury.

instructions.name: update_config
docs: Admin-only: rotate treasury / fees.

errors.name: InvalidTreasury
errors.msg: Treasury account does not match config

errors.name: ZeroAmount
errors.msg: Amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: InsufficientVaultBalance
errors.msg: Vault balance would drop below rent floor

errors.name: LosingBet
errors.msg: Bet is on the losing side

fields.name: pending_admin
docs: Nominated admin awaiting `accept_admin`.

fields.name: resolver
docs: Off-chain Stovia resolver for sealed (Privacy Rings) bets.

fields.name: real_sol
docs: SOL actually held by the curve (excl. rent).

fields.name: real_tokens
docs: Tokens still in the curve vault.

fields.name: creator_fees_accrued
docs: Unclaimed creator fees in the creator fee vault (excl. rent).

fields.name: twap_cumulative
docs: Sum of mcap_lamports * seconds over [start_ts, last_ts].

fields.name: sealed_committed
docs: Number of sealed (Privacy Rings) bets committed / revealed. Amounts are never on-chain.

fields.name: commitment
docs: sha256(side_u8 || salt[32] || bettor)

fields.name: stake_commitment
docs: sha256(amount_le_u64 || salt2[32] || bettor): binds the private Rings stake.

types.name: SolVault
docs: Lamport-holding PDA (curve SOL, bond, creator fees, market escrow).

fields.name: sol_amount
docs: Buy: gross SOL paid. Sell: net SOL received.
